titulo: Three ways to ask for a hand
caption:
Three ways to ask for a hand

I used to sigh at a heavy load until someone offered. Then I started saying I needed help.

People are often glad to help and unsure whether to offer, so a clear ask tends to take the guessing out for both.

For whoever says what help is needed.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a table and a royal blue figure, in three labeled scenes. The hint: a teal figure trembles and says this is heavy... while the blue one looks away. The retreat: a brown figure says sorry, never mind. and shuts its eyes. The plain ask: an ink-black figure says I need help., and the blue one walks over, and both end with happy eyes. The text stays: three kinds of asking for help. The last card: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
